_comment: globalConcurrencyLimit bounds children WITHIN one batch. It does NOT bound how wide a `runs.all` fan-out may open, which upstream also states in its own docs; keep a fan-out inside the provider's concurrency budget in the `concurrency` map of config/routing.json yourself. `parallel.maxTasks` and `parallel.concurrency` are dormant as of pi-subagents 0.57.0 — their resolvers are never called — and are kept set so a later release finds a conservative value already here. A run also carries a cumulative child budget, maxSubagentSpawnsPerRun, default 64 and live unset. See docs/adr/0005-unbounded-fan-out-on-runs-all.md.
